name: The Westin Perth
insider_take: Perth's only luxury skyscraper hotel offering sweeping views of the Swan River and Kings Park – one of the world's largest inner-city parks.
whats_special: The Westin Perth stands as the city's tallest hotel at 40 stories, featuring the signature Westin Heavenly Beds and a rooftop bar with 360-degree views. The hotel sits atop the historic GPO building, seamlessly blending Perth's heritage with modern luxury. Its prime location puts you steps from Perth's cultural quarter and the beautiful Swan River foreshore.
pro_tip: Book a Swan River view room on floors 25+ for unobstructed sunset views over the water and Kings Park. The evening light show is spectacular and free from your window.
dont_miss: Visit Kings Park's treetop walk and botanical gardens (just a 10-minute stroll), explore the trendy laneways of Perth's cultural precinct below, and experience Rottnest Island – home to the adorable quokkas – just a 90-minute ferry ride away via nearby Elizabeth Quay.
pros: Prime location in Perth's CBD with easy access to shopping and business districts
Signature Westin Heavenly Bed for exceptional sleep comfort
WestinWORKOUT fitness studio with state-of-the-art equipment
Elegant accommodations with modern amenities and city views
cons: Premium pricing reflective of luxury positioning
Urban setting may not suit guests seeking quiet retreat
